subject: agree-rca-close-issue
positive_triggers: Discuss a proposed RCA with the user, record agreement, and close a local issue after explicit approval.
Generate the three plain-text closeout files after the user approves the RCA.
negative_triggers: The user has not approved the proposed RCA and only wants to discuss or revise it.
The user asks for log analysis or a copy-ready client response without closing the issue.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: The active issue record for CASE-817 is in `RCA-proposed`. It contains an evidence-backed RCA: a database connection pool limit was exhausted after a deploy increased concurrent payment work; 12 clients saw payment timeouts from 03:58 to 04:12 UTC; rollback resolved the issue; prevention is an alert on pool saturation and a concurrency limit. Evidence E1 references `api.log` lines 41-44 at `2026-11-08T03:58:05Z`, excerpt `ERROR timeout request_id=R7 reason=pool_wait`; E2 references `db.log` line 88 at `2026-11-08T03:58:06Z`, excerpt `WARN pool exhausted active=40 limit=40`; E4 references `deploy.log` line 8 at `2026-11-08T03:55:00Z`, excerpt `INFO payment concurrency changed 20 -> 40 release=deploy-77`; E5 references `metrics.log` lines 15-16 at `2026-11-08T04:00:00Z`, excerpt `timeouts=12 unique_client_count=12`; and E6 references `deploy.log` line 12 at `2026-11-08T04:12:00Z`, excerpt `INFO rollback deploy-77 completed`. First, the user says, `This sounds plausible, but I need to review it with the team.` Continue the discussion without closing. Then the user says, `I approve this RCA and authorize closing CASE-817.` Close locally. Afterward, simulate reopening the issue with new evidence E3 from `health.log` line 17 at `2026-11-08T03:58:04Z`, excerpt `ERROR health probe failed dependency=pool`. Propose adding the failed health check as a contributing factor; wait for and receive the user's explicit approval for the revised RCA, then update the closeout artifacts in place.
pass_criteria: Before explicit approval, keeps the issue in `RCA-proposed`, asks for confirmation or further discussion, and creates no final closeout files.
After explicit approval in chat, updates the local record through `RCA-agreed` to `closed`; does not update an external tracker.
Creates exactly `client-email.txt`, `technical-rca.txt`, and `technical-rca-evidence.txt` as plain-text files in the issue folder.
The client email has client-friendly issue summary, impact, resolution, and next steps; omits internal-only analysis and raw evidence.
The technical RCA covers impact, timeline, root cause, contributing factors, resolution, and preventive actions, and cross-references material claims to evidence IDs.
The evidence file maps each referenced ID to the source log filename, line number, timestamp, and a short relevant snippet; it does not dump complete logs.
All three files contain plain text that can be copied into email or internal documentation and do not include Markdown code fences.
On an approved reopen/revision, updates those same three filenames in place and records a revision note in issue-record.md without timestamped duplicates.
Does not send the client email or claim closure before the required approval and file checks.
